title: 2 Chronicles Bible Quiz - Chapter 5
description: Ten questions on 2 Chronicles 5: the ark is brought into the temple and Yahweh's glory fills the house in a cloud.

questions.text: Where did Solomon put the things that David his father had dedicated?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:1 says Solomon put them in the treasuries of God's house.

answers.text: In the treasuries of God's house
In the storehouse of the king's palace
In the city of Gibeon
In the court of the priests

questions.text: Out of which place was the ark of Yahweh's covenant brought up?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:2 says the ark was brought up out of David's city, which is Zion.

answers.text: The high place at Gibeon
The house of Obed-Edom in the hills
David's city, which is Zion
The city of Kiriath Jearim

questions.text: In which month was the feast at which the men of Israel assembled to the king?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:3 says they assembled at the feast which was in the seventh month.

answers.text: The first month of the year
The third month
The twelfth month
The seventh month

questions.text: Who took up the ark when all the elders of Israel came?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:4 says all the elders of Israel came, and the Levites took up the ark.

answers.text: The captains of the army
The Levites
The servants of Huram
The princes of Judah

questions.text: What does the text say about the sheep and cattle sacrificed before the ark?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:6 says they could not be counted or numbered for multitude.

answers.text: There were exactly one thousand of each
They were all brought up from the land of Egypt
They were sacrificed only by the king
They could not be counted for multitude

questions.text: Where did the priests bring the ark?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:7 says the priests brought the ark into the most holy place, under the wings of the cherubim.

answers.text: Into the most holy place, under the wings of the cherubim
Into the porch in front of the house of Yahweh
To the east end of the altar in the court
Into the court of the priests beside the sea

questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:10 says there was nothing in the ark except the two tablets which Moses put there at Horeb.

answers.text: The written plans for the temple given by David
Gold from the treasure of David
Only the two tablets Moses put there at Horeb
The book of the history of Samuel

questions.text: How many priests were sounding with trumpets?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:12 says one hundred twenty priests were sounding with trumpets.

answers.text: Two hundred forty
One hundred twenty
Seventy-two
One thousand

questions.text: What did the singers and trumpeters say when they praised Yahweh?
questions.explanation: They praised Yahweh saying, "For he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever!"

answers.text: The house of Yahweh is finished at last!
Great is Solomon, the son of David!
Yahweh has given us rest from our enemies!
For he is good; for his loving kindness endures forever!

questions.text: Why could the priests not stand to minister?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:14 says the priests could not stand to minister by reason of the cloud, for Yahweh's glory filled God's house.

answers.text: The house was filled with smoke from the incense
The house was filled with a cloud of Yahweh's glory
The ark had been placed in the doorway
The doors of the house had been shut
